title: Savitch machine program
statement: For a natural number $E$, define a register-machine program with $18$ registers, four deciders, and labels in the family indexed by $E$. At each label it supplies the corresponding instruction: the program scans the input length, computes its parameters and code bound, searches pairs of codes, and performs the recursive reachability procedure using the move, copy, shift, doubling, subtraction, and halving loops specified by the labels.
caveat: The declaration is a large case-by-case program definition; a compact prose summary cannot enumerate every label-to-instruction assignment without reproducing the formal definition.
